rule: Keep the separate Feature agent and Critic only if the one-agent design is worse on paired folds: the correlation-corrected 95% CI of the PR-AUC difference (one agent minus three agents, both with definitions; each fold first averaged over runs) lies entirely below 0. Otherwise fold them into one agent.
caveat: The variance correction is approximate. The configurations were selected using the same development providers, so this is not nested evaluation. An interval crossing zero does not establish equivalence; folding follows the stated simplicity rule.
